title: Great night of cooking, laughing, learning and eating!
text: We highly recommend this thoroughly enjoyable class! Ana and Tony were absolutely skilled, welcoming and engaging! We had so much fun cooking and chatting with everyone and Ana and Tony set the friendly vibe that made it like an evening with friends. The recipes were a great learning experience and the food was delicious-some  of the best we had in Sevilla and Spain!  Thank you Ana and Tony!

title: Highlight of  our trip!
text: This tour and cooking class was the highlight of our Spanish adventure.  We had a group of 5 couples and we all felt that way.  Everything about  it was exceptional....1  Lily gave us an informative, entertaining tour or the market and then she and Leo directed our cooking class.   They were great instructors - so funny!  The food was amazing.

title: Must Do in Barcelona
text: Perfect evening with an amazing chef who taught us how to make Paella, Sangria and Gazpacho and made sure we were hands on. The view from his rooftop was indescribable as were the people we met
